title: Parity vectors and paradoxical sequences in the accelerated Collatz map
notes: docs/problems/juggler_jump_spectrum.md. WITHDRAWN 20 May 2026, the author citing redundancy with rozier-terracol-2026; v1 remains downloadable and was read in full, 12 pages. Followed only because hikawa-2026-parity-vector-structures cites it for 'a sharp finitary form of Terras's density in the length basis', which sounded like the polynomial correction and is not. Its Theorem 2 is the mod-2^k statement: the parity vector of length k cuts out a single residue class, so the count in [1,N] lies between floor(N/2^k) and ceil(N/2^k) -- a deviation bounded by one element, an equidistribution sharpening and not an asymptotic for N_d. Its other results enumerate paradoxical sequences. Nothing here bears on the survivor asymptotic; the trail ends.
